hero.title: Your website. In 7 days. 990 CHF.
hero.lead: We build websites for small Swiss businesses. Fixed price, fixed deadline. You pay once the site is live.

included.title: What 990 CHF includes
included.lead: A complete website that works on every device and is legally sound. Nothing you have to buy afterwards just to be able to use it.

items.d: More than half your visitors arrive on a phone. The site is built for that format, not adapted to it afterwards.
We write the text. You supply the facts, we put them in a form your customers will actually read.
Photos of your projects, cleaned up and compressed so the site stays fast.
First year included. The domain belongs to you, not to us — including if you move to someone else later.
Enquiries land straight in your inbox. With spam protection and no third-party trackers.
An encrypted connection. Without one the browser shows your customers a warning.
Written for your business, under Swiss law.
You see the draft, tell us what should change, we change it. Twice, at no extra cost.

included.footnote: Delivered in seven working days, counted from the day your content reaches us.

steps.d: Fifteen minutes on the phone. We work out what your business needs — and what it doesn't. Free and without obligation.
You send photos, details and anything that should go on the site. Whatever is missing, we draft and put in front of you.
Your website is ready within seven working days. You review it, we correct it. Two rounds are included.
Domain, hosting, SSL. The invoice arrives once the site is live. Not before.

guarantee.title: Seven days. Or you pay nothing.
guarantee.lead: If your website is not live on the eighth working day, it is yours free. Not discounted — free.

points.d: The invoice comes after the site goes live. Before that, not a franc moves.
It runs from the day your content reaches us in full. We tell you in advance what we need.
990 francs is 990 francs. There are no add-on invoices for things we forgot to count.

prices.title: Every price in the open
prices.lead: Most agencies write «quote on request». We write what it costs. That way you can see in two minutes whether we are a fit.

stats.d: The whole home page, stylesheet and every image included. An average company site weighs fifteen times as much.
No Google, no ad network, no cookie banner. Everything is served from your own site's server.
German, French, Italian, English — exactly the work we do for you.
All built from a single source. Change a price and it changes in every language.

items.a: Because we are a small studio, we pay no rent on Bahnhofstrasse, and there is no layer of project managers in between. We build websites for small businesses to a practised process. The same work costs four to five times as much at a conventional agency, because four to five people there earn from it.
Cantelo is a small studio. We work without an office and without a sales force, and instead deal with you directly. Our full details are in the legal notice.

No. We work from abroad and serve Swiss businesses. Your website is hosted in Switzerland, the domain is registered in your name, and the invoice only comes once the site is live. The risk therefore sits with us, not with you. If you want a supplier with an office in your municipality, we are not the right choice — we would rather say so now than after the first call.

items.q: What if I don't like the result?
items.a: Two rounds of revisions are included. You pay only after acceptance. If we have not convinced you after two rounds, we have not done our job.

items.q: How long does it really take?
items.a: Seven working days from the moment all the content is with us. In practice that is where things usually stall: gathering photos and details often takes longer than the website itself. On the first call we tell you exactly what we need.

Not the change packages. Hosting, the domain and SSL are needed by every website — you can also handle that yourself or buy it elsewhere. We offer it because most businesses would rather not deal with it, not because it is impossible without us.

items.q: And if I cancel the maintenance?
items.a: You receive all the files of your website, and the domain stays with you. There is nothing holding you here.

items.q: Can you also do German, French or Italian?
items.a: Yes, 290 francs per additional language version. This website itself exists in four languages — so you can see what you are getting.

items.q: I already have a website. Is this worth it?
items.a: It depends. If your current site works on a phone and brings in enquiries, keep it. Send us the link — if we see no reason to rebuild it, we will say so.

agb.title: General terms and conditions
agb.intro: These terms apply to all contracts concluded between Cantelo and the client, unless otherwise agreed in writing.

p: Cantelo produces a website within the scope described in the offer. The scope of the basic service at 990 francs is set out on this website under «What you get». Add-on services are provided only where expressly agreed.

The client provides the content required for the website, in particular photographs, business details and contact data, and confirms being entitled to use them. The period of seven working days begins once all the required content is available.
Two rounds of revisions are included in the price. A round of revisions means one consolidated set of feedback on the draft submitted. Each further round is charged at 90 francs.
The invoice is issued after the website goes live and is payable within 30 days. If the client raises no objection within ten days of going live, the service is deemed accepted.
The domain is registered in the client's name. The first year of the .ch domain is included in the price. Thereafter the registrar's fees apply, which are covered within a maintenance plan.
Maintenance plans run for twelve months and renew automatically for twelve months at a time. They may be cancelled up to one month before the end of the term.

The number of small changes included depends on the plan chosen. Unused changes expire at the end of the month and are not carried over. Small changes means adjustments to text, photographs, prices, opening hours and contact details, as well as adding a review. New pages, new sections, new features and redesigns do not count as small changes.
On termination of the maintenance relationship the client receives all files of the website in usable form. The domain remains with the client.
Once payment has been made in full, the rights of use in the website produced pass to the client. Cantelo remains entitled to name the project as a reference unless the client objects.
Cantelo is liable for damage caused by intent or gross negligence. Any further liability, in particular for lost profit or indirect damage, is excluded to the extent permitted by law.
The contractual relationship is governed by Swiss law. The place of jurisdiction is [INSERT PLACE OF JURISDICTION].
